LG Uplus
(LG U+) provides mobile, internet, and IPTV services in South Korea. It features major product brands like
U+tv
U+ Mobile TV
ixi-O
(AI call assistant), and specialized kids' content portals, partnering with hardware makers like
Samsung
and smart home providers like
Aqara

Key Product Brands & Services
U+tv & U+tv Free:
IPTV service including tablet-hybrid options like the iPad-based
U+tv Free5 for iPad
U+ Mobile TV:
In-app and in-vehicle live streaming and video-on-demand services.
ixi-O:
Proprietary AI-powered communication and call-assistant agent.
U+ Kids (U+ Kids World):
Specialized interactive children’s educational and entertainment content.
U-dok:
Multi-subscription platform bundling external AI and streaming apps.
Telecompaper
Major Manufacturer & Technology Partners
Samsung Electronics:
Hardware collaborator for custom and budget 5G devices (such as the
Galaxy Buddy
series) and kids' niche concept phones.
Apple:
Device partner for iPad-integrated home media bundles.
Aqara (LUMI United):
Co-branded smart home security and IoT sensor systems.
Kiwi Plus:
Software and hardware sourcing partner for customized youth smart devices.
Global OTT Giants:
Strategic integration partners for content delivery, including
Netflix
Disney+
